observations: A large frontal face-like form fills the canvas; a bold red X crosses the right cheek area, outlined in white against a pink field, drawing the eye to center-right.
Yellow looping lines radiate from the top of the form, while a flat yellow horizontal band with white zigzag lines cuts across the left mid-section.
The mouth zone is built from stacked rectangular shapes with white zigzag lines and red oval forms below, set against a dark lower area layered with blue, teal, and black scribbled lines.
reading: The face-like form holds its ground through density: lines pile onto lines, yet the red X and yellow loops keep pulling focus back to two fixed points. The zigzag bands read as something between stitching and static. Tension sits in the gap between the locked rectangular eye socket on the left and the open, crossed-out cheek on the right — one contained, one cancelled.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #183 and nnxyz nnotb #185 both use close-cropped face-like structures with layered scribble fields, but #184 pushes its single form to the canvas edge on all sides.

connections.reason: nnxyz nnotb #185 shares the close-cropped single face format and yellow-dominant radiating loops, but sets them against a black ground rather than a multicolor layered field, sharpening the contrast.
nnxyz nnotb #183 uses the same zigzag-mouth construction and layered scribble field but distributes multiple face-like figures across the canvas rather than locking one form to the frame.

lookingQuestion: The red X and the rectangular eye socket sit on opposite sides of the face — what does your eye do in the space between them?
ambiguities: The small signature mark in the lower-right corner is visible but not fully legible at this resolution.
Title-number order and recorded-creation order align for this work in the owned subset, but gaps elsewhere in the series mean neither confirms a strict making sequence.
